scenes.description: Waking up at Seven O'Clock with the Golden Morning Alarm
Eating Delicious Lunch at Noon Twelve Thirty in the Canteen
Bedtime at Nine O'Clock under Gentle Starry Night Sky

character_line.en: Ring ring! The morning bell is chiming! What time is it now?
character_line.zh: 鈴鈴鈴！早晨鬧鐘響起來了！現在是幾點鐘呢？

options.en: It is seven o'clock! Time to wake up!
options.zh: 現在是七點鐘！該起床囉！

options.hint: 看看時鐘指在七點，說「It is seven o'clock」喔！
告訴 Benny 現在七點該起床展開美好的一天囉！

character_line.en: The short hand points to seven and the long hand to twelve! What should we do now?
character_line.zh: 短針指著七、長針指著十二！我們現在該做什麼呢？

options.en: Brush our teeth and eat tasty breakfast!
options.zh: 刷刷牙，然後吃美味的早餐！

options.hint: 早晨七點起床後要刷牙吃美味早餐喔！
告訴 Benny 七點晨起該做的健康晨光活動吧！

character_line.en: Our tummies are rumbling! What time is lunchtime?
character_line.zh: 我們的肚子咕嚕嚕叫了！午餐時間是幾點呢？

options.en: It is half past twelve! Time for lunch!
options.zh: 現在是十二點半！該吃午餐了！

options.hint: 看看鐘面指在十二點半「half past twelve」吃午餐囉！
告訴 Benny 十二點半是吃午餐的美味時刻喔！

character_line.en: Yum, rice and carrots! How many minutes do we have for recess?
character_line.zh: 好香的米飯和紅蘿蔔！我們下課休息有幾分鐘呢？

options.en: We have thirty minutes to play outside!
options.zh: 我們有三十分鐘可以在外面玩！

options.hint: 回答下課休息有三十分鐘「thirty minutes」喔！
算算看下課有幾分鐘可以跟朋友在操場跑跳吧！

character_line.en: Look out the window, the stars are shining! What time is it?
character_line.zh: 看看窗外，星星閃閃發光！現在是幾點鐘了？

options.en: It is nine o'clock! Time for sweet dreams!
options.zh: 現在是九點鐘！該進入甜美夢鄉囉！

options.hint: 夜晚九點鐘「nine o'clock」該準時上床睡覺囉！
告訴 Benny 星空出來了，現在九點該睡覺囉！

character_line.en: Good night, little learner! Have wonderful dreams!
character_line.zh: 晚安，親愛的小朋友！祝你有個美好的夢！

options.en: Good night, Benny! See you tomorrow!

options.hint: 互道晚安說「Good night, Benny!」明天見喔！
溫柔地跟小熊 Benny 說晚安明天再一起玩吧！
